findings.problem: GLOW-ben teaches the wrong sound: German au sounds like the ow in how, not the o in glow, so a learner would say glohben.
findings.fix: trick: GLAUBEN and English beLIEVE come from the same old word: the -laub- in glauben is the -lief- in belief.

back.target: to believe (also: to think, have an opinion)
back.example: I don't believe a word you say.

note: This card and the word's other card ("to think", for an opinion) both have the target glauben, so they don't conflict.
